description: This file defines classes related to silo runtime statistics within an Orleans distributed system. It includes data structures for capturing current statistics such as activation counts, memory usage, CPU utilization, overload status, message counts, and detailed grain information.

classes.name: SiloRuntimeStatistics
classes.description: A snapshot of current runtime statistics for a silo, including activation counts, memory and CPU usage, message counts, overload status, and environment statistics.

classes.name: SimpleGrainStatistic
classes.description: Represents current statistics for a specific grain type on a silo, including activation count.

classes.name: DetailedGrainStatistic
classes.description: Provides detailed statistics for a grain, including grain type, silo address, and grain ID.

classes.name: DetailedGrainReport
classes.description: Contains detailed report information about a specific grain on a silo, including addresses, class type, and activation info.

methods.name: SiloRuntimeStatistics
methods.description: Constructor initializing runtime statistics with system metrics, environment stats, and load options.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Overrides ToString to produce a detailed string representation of the silo runtime statistics.

methods.name: ToString (in DetailedGrainReport)
methods.description: Provides a formatted string summarizing detailed grain report data.
